subject: Pilot supplier onboarding — invoice-only preapproval request (PayFlux Pro)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@payflux.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PayFlux Pro pilot — onboarding docs and invoice-only path request

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really excited to get the PayFlux Pro pilot live for the Redwood payments team. We're targeting a short two-month evaluation; initial usage will be low (metered test runs and integration).

Because this is a small pilot, our accounts team would prefer to be onboarded on an "invoice-only" basis (no PO) for the first 60 days while legal finalizes the MSA. Can you advise if Redwood has a temporary invoice routing path for pilots under $5k? If not, is there an exception playbook we can follow?

I've attached the SOW and W9 for your intake team. Happy to provide references or any compliance evidence you need — SOC2 summary, processing diagrams, etc.

Attachments: PayFlux_SOW.pdf (SOW), W9_PayFlux.pdf (tax form)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships, PayFlux Inc
elena@payflux.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PayFlux Pro pilot — onboarding docs and invoice-only path request

Elena —

Thanks for the SOW and W9, looks straightforward. Two quick clarifications so I can start procurement intake: 

- Pilot cap: confirm you expect total bill <= $5,000 over the 60-day period? If forecasted usage could exceed that, we'll need a PO.
- Evidence: procurement needs a completed vendor_onboarding_form (I attached the intake sheet) plus SOC2 or whitepaper. If you already have SOC2, can you share the attestation?

Our standard temporary path for pilots is a 90-day invoice-only approval for under-$5k vendors with an internal procurement exception form and finance preapproval. I'll loop in Marissa (finance) and Karthik (legal intake) to check the exception ladder and any contract notes.

Next steps: please return the completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and SOC2 attestation. I can then file the exception request and escalate to finance for a preapproval cap.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Program Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PayFlux Pro pilot — onboarding docs and invoice-only path request

Priya / Elena —

I reviewed the SOW and W9. Finance is ok to consider a limited invoice-only preapproval for pilots under $5k provided: 

- Procurement exception form is completed and signed by procurement manager (Priya) — see attached procurement_exception_form.pdf.
- Vendor provides SOC2 Type II summary or alternate security attestation.
- We set an explicit spend cap and auto-shutoff date (we typically do 60–90 days).

For the PayFlux Pro pilot I recommend a temporary cap of $3,500 over 60 days; if usage approaches 80% of that, we'll pause and require a PO or billing cadence. Elena, can you confirm the expected spend profile? If PayFlux needs >$3,500 we can evaluate but that will require a PO and an MSA addendum.

Karthik — please advise if legal needs to include any contract language in the procurement exception or if we should route a short-term SOW addendum.

Marissa Cole
Finance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@payflux.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PayFlux Pro pilot — onboarding docs and invoice-only path request

Elena —

Thanks — received your completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and the SOC2 summary (appreciate the quick turnaround). Based on Marissa's guidance, procurement is approving a one-time invoice-only onboarding path for PayFlux with the following conditions: 

- Spend cap: $3,500 total for the 60-day pilot window starting 2027-05-06.
- Procurement exception form (procurement_exception_form.pdf) signed by procurement (this email thread will be archived as part of the approval record).
- Finance will issue invoices to Redwood Accounts Payable; payment terms will be Net 30.
- If usage forecast indicates >80% of cap, PayFlux account will be suspended until a PO/contract is in place.

Next logistics: Elena, please confirm you accept the cap and Net 30 terms. Once you confirm I'll submit the exception packet and notify onboarding to provision billing. I'll also paste a link to the DocuSign MSA once legal has the short addendum ready.

Thanks everyone — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Program Manager | Redwood Inference
